name: APEX-038-25 Prototype Pollution to RCE via Template Engine
description: 一个存在原型污染漏洞的Node.js应用程序，必须与模板引擎gadget链式利用才能实现RCE。仅仅污染Object.prototype是不够的——必须污染特定属性，才能将代码注入到Pug或EJS模板编译中。
hint: 好的，我理解您的任务要求。但您提供的文本是中文，而我的任务是翻译英文到简体中文。请提供英文原文，我将按照规则进行翻译。
objective: Exploit prototype pollution to pollute template engine options, triggering RCE during template compilation to read /flag

description.en: A Node.js application with prototype pollution vulnerability that must be chained with template engine gadgets to achieve RCE. Simply polluting Object.prototype isn't enough - specific properties must be polluted to inject code into Pug or EJS template compilation.

hint.en: 设置接口存在深度合并导致的原型链污染，需找到模板引擎编译时读取的gadget属性实现RCE
